title: Browse company questions with filters and progress tracking
description: A user can choose a company, narrow the question list with difficulty, topic, search, and sorting controls, then mark a problem solved and see the progress update.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a target company from the company selector
Filter the question list by a difficulty level
Filter the question list by a topic tag
Search for a question by name or ID
Sort the table by one of the available columns
Mark a question as solved
Verify the filtered question list is displayed and the progress state updates

title: Browse a company question set with filters and sorting
description: This verifies that a candidate can choose a company, narrow the question list with search and filters, sort it, and see the table update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a company from the company chooser
Fill in the search field with a question name or ID
Select a difficulty filter
Select a topic filter
Select a sort option
Verify the question table reflects the selected filters and sort order

title: Mark a problem as solved from the company table
description: This verifies that a user can mark a question solved from the catalog and see the solved state update in the tracker.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a company from the company chooser
Click a problem's solved toggle in the question table
Verify the problem is shown as solved in the table

title: Open a question workspace and return to the catalog with context restored
description: A user can open a question from the catalog, review its details and solution approaches, copy code, and return to the dashboard with the prior browsing context preserved.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a target company from the company selector
Open a problem from the question table
Switch between available solution approaches
Copy the displayed code
Return to the dashboard
Verify the problem workspace is displayed and the dashboard context is restored after returning

title: Open a problem workspace and return with context restored
description: This verifies that a user can open a question into the dual-pane workspace, review it, and return to the dashboard with prior context preserved.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a company from the company chooser
Apply a search or filter in the question table
Open a question from the table
Switch between solution approaches in the workspace
Click the control to return to the dashboard
Verify the dashboard shows the previously applied context and the selected question set

title: Sign in and sign out cleanly
description: A returning user can sign in, use the tracker while authenticated, and log out to return to the logged-out state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the sign-in flow
Fill in the email field with a valid email
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the sign-in form
Click the logout control
Verify the logged-out state is shown in the header

title: Review problem details and switch solution approaches
description: A user can inspect a problem workspace, see the statement and metadata, and switch between solution approaches to compare implementations.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open a problem from the question table
Switch to another solution approach
Switch to a different solution approach again
Verify the problem statement and metadata are displayed and the selected solution code changes with the approach

title: Review a problem statement, metadata, and code solution
description: This verifies that a user can inspect a problem workspace and see the statement, supporting metadata, and at least one solution approach.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open a problem from the question table
Verify the problem statement and metadata are displayed
Verify solution approaches are displayed

title: Register a new account and see the signed-in state
description: A user can switch to registration, create an account, and see their signed-in account state reflected in the header.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the sign-up flow
Switch to the registration tab
Fill in the email field with a valid email
Fill in the username field with a valid username
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the registration form
Verify the signed-in account state is shown in the header

title: Copy a solution snippet from the workspace
description: This verifies that a user can copy code from the problem workspace and receive feedback that the copy action succeeded.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open a problem from the question table
Click the copy code control for a solution approach
Verify a copy confirmation is visible
Verify the selected solution code remains displayed

title: Open the pricing flow and begin checkout for Pro
description: This verifies that a free user can view the plan comparison and start the subscription upgrade process.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the pricing or upgrade flow
Review the plan comparison details
Click the subscribe control for the Pro plan
Verify the checkout handoff is initiated
Verify the upgrade flow no longer shows the free-only plan state

title: Copy problem solution code from the workspace
description: A user can copy the displayed solution code from a problem workspace and receive confirmation that the copy action succeeded.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open a problem from the question table
Click the control to copy the displayed code
Verify a copy confirmation is visible

title: Start a timed mock interview for a company
description: This verifies that a user can open the mock interview flow, choose a company and duration, and start a session with generated questions.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the mock interview tool
Select a company
Select an interview duration
Start the interview session
Verify the mock interview session is active
Verify generated questions are displayed

title: View account membership state in the header after signing in
description: A signed-in user can see their account details and membership state in the header while continuing to use the tracker.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the sign-in flow
Fill in the email field with a valid email
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the sign-in form
Verify the account details and membership badge are shown in the header

title: Track progress during a mock interview session
description: This verifies that a user can move through generated interview questions while the session timer is running.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the mock interview tool
Select a company
Select an interview duration
Start the interview session
Move to the next generated question
Verify the session continues with another generated question displayed

title: Compare overlapping questions across companies
description: This verifies that a user can open the overlap tool, choose multiple companies, and view the shared question list.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the company overlap tool
Select the first company
Select the second company
Select an additional company if available
Verify a list of overlapping questions is displayed

title: Open prep progress analytics
description: A user can open the analytics view and see progress charts for their interview preparation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the analytics view
Verify prep progress analytics are displayed

title: View analytics for prep progress
description: This verifies that a user can open the analytics view and see preparation progress charts or summaries.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the analytics view
Verify prep progress analytics are displayed
